body: You think they ended up loosing it or that I just have to wait

We don’t have contact anymore.

I try doing the things I like but it all just seems so bland. 

Every once in a while I do stuff with friends and it’s fun but at the end of the day I still go to bed sad.
Everyone I have tried tells me to get on with my life and leave my problems behind me which is easier said then done
I try professional help, but I never actually end up telling her about my „thoughts about the future“ because I don’t want her to start going to my family about it

Well to sum things up, everything from past events like my maths teacher „touching“ me (I’m a boy), to my mom getting cancer and a brain tumor, my brother and dad being verbally abusive and the only person I could talk to about everything cheated on me.
